steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I was wondering why you would have that immobile Sarkaz along with you.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Now I know.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Um... Monique? I'm not sure I get it...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Then shut your mouth and stop embarrassing yourself.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The Armorless Union, is it? What do you want?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: First things first, please allow me to apologize to the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That is, for the Armorless Union's kidnapping of your sister, Maria—

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: —Hey, hold your beasties. It wasn't my doing.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You... you wretched henchmen!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Maria should already have made it home safe. Relax. We have no more tricks to pull on you, and suppose we were going to do anything else, we would've gone for... less perfect results.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We at the Armorless Union are just doing our jobs, even if it's not exactly what we want to do. We've got eyes on us from above. You know what I mean?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You're attacking the Infected.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That's how the bosses arranged things. Don't lay the blame on us.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The cause doesn't clear you of your crimes.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I guess you're right...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But isn't that why we're paying you a visit today?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We have nothing to say to each other. If it is a fight you want, it is a fight you'll get.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hey, now, let's cool our tempers, shall we? I'll be frank. We want to shake off the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: We're here today to make this clear. We're on different sides. I mean, we still belong to the Chamber...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But would you be willing to sign a peace treaty with us?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You, the Radiant Knight, the Nearl family and its subordinates, as well as this 'Rhodes Island.' I am hoping you will all refrain from getting in the way of our plans.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: In return, the Armorless Union won't interfere with your quest for glory or lay a finger on anyone that's got anything to do with you.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: What about the Infected...?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Sorry, but we can't possibly do everything either.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The Infected are a threat to us. Not to worry, though. We have a use for those Infected knights too.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: To take the fall for you?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: That's not what I want, Armorless Union.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: —What is the Armorless Union?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Long ago, the local farmers and affinities pulled together and hired a group of veteran assassins to stand up to an indulgent knight noble.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: But they all failed—Every last one of them.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The knight hanged the traitors atop his castle, to make an example of them. The villagers in the territory could only keep their mouths shut and give up their fight.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Some time after that, however, there was an archer who took matters into his own hands. Back then, everyone figured that bows and arrows were no match for a Kuranta knight's speed, so they weren't really holding their breaths.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Yet when the cruel knight's family awoke the next morning, they found the knight impaled through the ground by a long spear, mid-charge, his head still looking up.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: When the crowd got closer, they realized it wasn't a spear at all. It was an arrow. An arrow forged by Darksteel.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: 'Darksteel,' the very first member of the Armorless Union.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'm very well aware that we're hired killers, but nonetheless...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Legends like these aren't always without merit.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: —Nearl! Above you!
The Radiant Knight lifts her head.
The streets are only barely lit, and the stars on the night sky are twinkling brilliantly.
Among them, a lone shooting star twinkles a few times before straying from the rest of the meteor shower's path.
It falls straight to the ground.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: —An arrow?!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Break it!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Roger—!

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Aaah—?!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Liz, watch out!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: (Nearl and I both struck it at the same time... and... it didn't break?)

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Are you two okay?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: I-I'm fine... W-What was that just now?
Margaret looks to her side in silence.
There is a pitch black arrow long as a spear burrowed into the concrete.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Impressive... I've never seen anyone react to Darksteel's shots in time, much less dodge them.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Your swordsmanship is as impressive as the rumors say, Radiant Knight. That was an eye-popping maneuver from the Confessarius, too... Luckily, the arrow's not life deadly—

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: —Is that the smell of souls, Sarkaz?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I never expected to see such fine swordsmanship and Arts... from a doctor like you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Save it... So much for your peace treaty.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'm sure you know already, but that shot wasn't meant to take your lives. The Sarkaz sitting over there would be thoroughly dead otherwise.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: So, now that we've broken the ice, please do give our proposal some thought.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I hope you understand that one shot just now, but the Armorless Union isn't begging on bended knee—

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: There are three 'Darksteels.'

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: How many of their arrows can you dodge?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Stop right there!
The Armorless Union members' figures disappear into the gap between the neon signs and the moonlight.
All that remains is the reverberating jazz music.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: 'Darksteel...' a metal with an obsidian-like luster. Very heavy.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It came falling down from the dark night sky... just as the name implies.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: From the... night sky?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The night sky...
The Radiant Knight looks up again.
There are twinkling stars everywhere, seemingly ready to strike down and ambush them at any moment.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: This arrow... They must have shot it from far away. It was the high slope of the trajectory that made it seem like it fell from the sky.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: That makes no sense.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The Armorless Union... and 'Darksteel.' If everything's just like the smooth-tongued guy said, they were the origins of the term 'Armorless Union.'

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: These assassins might have their eyes on our heads right this moment.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: You're right. We need to be more alert. This is Kazimierz, after all.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It's the fortress of their crimes.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Malkiewicz...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What's the matter, Mr. McKee?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: It seems like you've lightened up a lot the past couple days. Did something happen?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: No... I just figured out what it is I should be doing.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Oh yes?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I heard you have a close relationship with Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals, and that you even arranged for their leader to meet with a few other corporations the other day?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: That's true... Is there a problem?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I'm sure you know, but public opinion on the Infected has been getting out of hand. We'll have to do something sooner or later.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Rhodes Island is one of the few foreign companies that operate in Area 0, but they have the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi's support nonetheless.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: We must treat this Rhodes Island seriously. Actually, a few of the executives have already made clear that they want us to investigate... and make sure they're dealt with.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Dealt with... huh?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: There are certain secrets about Area 0 that we can't let an outsider uncover.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: We're deploying the Armorless Union here, and the responsible party will again be given the Platinum's command.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The Armorless Union?!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: However... I also proposed to the Board that they put you in charge of this.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Mr. McKee! Thank you!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Don't mention it.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I'm hoping your relationship with Rhodes Island will keep things simple. When you do business in Kazimierz, you have to play by Kazimierz's rules.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Another thing... Please make sure word doesn't get out on this whole affair, lest things turn dangerous. Even though Platinum and most of the Armorless Union are still under control.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: There remains a problem with the Armorless Union's internal affairs. A huge problem.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Spacing out again? Are you bored?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Lately, a lot of people here in the Grand Knight Territory are boycotting the Infected knights.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If it weren't for that... Hehe... I would've loved to take a stroll around town with you.

options: Amiya is under a lot more pressure.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Well... but of course.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I find myself wondering... what is your company trying to do here in Kazimierz?

options: Closure's always complaining that we're in the red. We had to think of something.
Nearl also told us there are a lot of people here in Kazimierz who need help.
I asked her what her plan was.
I decided to give her my full support, and so did Amiya.
That's why we're here.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That's a pretty unsurprising answer.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Though, in the past, I would've thought it an excuse... I guess the Radiant Knight has pretty high standing at Rhodes Island?

options: I can't say I've given anyone's 'standing' that much thought.
I respect Nearl, and that's got nothing to do with standing.
Margaret Nearl is one of our operators. I've never thought of her as the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Kazimierz companies these days like to boast about having flat management structures, but it's actually a ploy to get the bottom-rung workers to let their guard down.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But if that's what you say, Doctor... then let's go with that.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Does this mean that if I come work part time at Rhodes Island right now, we'll be... on equal footing?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: My, I'm so jealous.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: You turned a blind eye to the Radiant Knight's title and status, treating her only as a person... and you still respect her nonetheless?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What about everyone else at Rhodes Island? Do they have your respect too? If so... I think I'm a little curious about this place now.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: There are a lot of knights who respect the Radiant Knight, though it's always for the same two reasons.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: It's either because she is a 'Nearl' or that she's 'the Radiant Knight.'

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: As a knight of Kazimierz, it's interesting to be given a different answer.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I was sold as a slave to Kazimierz. Ever since, my master taught me to be ready to give my life for others.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Even now, I'm ready to die for you, you know? Hehe.

options: Because you were tasked to be my bodyguard?
Because that's an order from the Adeptus?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That's how campaign knights are trained.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That's why the Radiant Knight's actions feel somewhat distant to me.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Do you think it's a noble thing to give your life for somebody else's ideals?

options: Of course.
Yes.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What if that person's ideal is to give their own life for somebody else? What would that get us in the end?

options: A better world.
As long as it's something better, I'd call that a win.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: That's a naive way of thinking. It's nothing like how sharp you were when dealing with the K.G.C.C.

options: Say, Gravel?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What is it?

options: If you don't think I'm worthy of your sacrifice, then don't make it.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: How could you say that? You're doubting my loyal—

options: If you think I'm worthy of your sacrifice, then live on for us.
You're a brilliant knight, and you're a partner of Rhodes Island.
You're free.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: What's on your mind?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Nothing, it's just... it's been a while since I last saw Darksteel make a move.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: When was it?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You weren't a Lazurite yet... It was when we took care of the last Platinum.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That Platinum was Centaurea's master... or something like that, I guess?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: It was raining that day. The time was 4:47 P.M., and I was just about to go on a business trip to another city.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I was the only Lazurite at the time, and I got a call all of a sudden. They told me that 'Platinum' betrayed us, and I had to take him out immediately.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: So...? Did you kill your coworker with your own two hands?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Nope. If I'd done that, I'm not sure I'd ever get a decent night's sleep again.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Actually, by the time we made it there... Haha... It was an unfinished building.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: The whole third floor was wrecked, and the traitor... was nailed to the wall high above the ground with one of Darksteel's heavy arrows pierced straight through his chest.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Now, I may be an amateur when it comes to on-site investigation, but I could tell that 'Platinum' tried to run away, only to get shot through the chest by the arrow mid-air, and pinned to the wall like that.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I was standing right under the wall, and the poor guy who fell in love with his target and tried to betray us was nailed right there above me.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I can still see it in my mind. I'd never seen a wall as white as that, and he looked like he really suffered.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Only an idiot would be fooled by somebody spouting freedom and platitudes. They don't understand what it actually means to survive.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hm... Are they finally making their move?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris, huh...?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Right, they're very cautious... but... they couldn't hold back any longer.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I mean, we've had those Infected boycott protests the last two days. It's ironic. I'm not even sure who's the victim here anymore.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: *Sigh*, another phone call? Does it ever stop?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hello—

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Why didn't you position yourself at the specified coordinates?

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: The Confessarius and the Radiant Knight wouldn't have blocked that arrow.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: You had them face north, and they saw my arrow in time.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: I could've killed the Sarkaz sitting on the chair at least.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Ahaha, I'm not sure what you're talking about—I can't just laugh this one off, eh?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That was my quick thinking, Boss. The Radiant Knight's a stubborn one. If you kill one of her friends, you'll just end up provoking her.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: If she'd lose her cool, I don't see why we shouldn't have.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That would've been too dangerous, Boss. Sorry for only cluing you in after the fact, but I think the threat level we're at is just right. Let's not overdo it.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Trust me. The Radiant Knight won't get in your way... By the way, may I ask how things are going right now?

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: The Board will figure this out soon... but no matter. When the city is paralyzed by the Infected...

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: I will end the last of the insiders, personally.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: And then no one alive will know the identities of the Armorless Union's highest ranking members.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: In position.

steps.name: Szewczyk
steps.text: Loud and clear.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: All ready.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Yeah! We can do this!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona... The backup power's kicking in way too fast. They might have improved their emergency measures.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Please... Please be careful.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hah, so you're saying I should put on an even bigger show?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: That's right, Wild Mane! Bash those Armorless Union bastards' brains in!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Of course! I'm ready, anytime!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona will ambush the Armorless Union's patrol head on.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: After half an hour, Ashley will ambush the supply sector. If we don't run into any surprises, the Adeptus's guards will be 'sent away' at that point.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I'll infiltrate the K.G.C.C. and take what we need. Easy peasy.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Okay... Let's get this started.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I can help you sneak into the building...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: But that's all I can do for you. You'll also need somebody to keep your escape route clear.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's more than enough. Thanks, Toland.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Don't forget what I said. What you folks are doing means much more than you can ever imagine.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Now, let everyone see this city cry its eyes out.
